}}'''Wakeda''' was a powerful [[Domani]] nobleman who became [[Dragonsworn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wakeda}} He was previously an officer serving under [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Appearance ==
He was of average height. He wore a black scarf over his missing right eye and had a scar running from his cheek to his forehead.

== Activities ==
He meets with Ituralde and the other Dragonsworn leaders, in Arad Doman under the [[White Ribbon]]. They agree to attack the [[Seanchan]] together on the [[Almoth Plain]]s.

He is with Ituralde's force when they destroy the Seanchan force outside [[Darluna]]. He is also with Ituralde when they decide to make their last stand in an [[Ogier]] ''[[stedding]]'' in Arad Doman. While there, they are visited by [[Rand al'Thor|the Dragon Reborn]] who offers them a way out by serving him instead.

He died during the [[Battle of Maradon]].
